text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There is a matter on which I would like 
your opinion. Yes... about special 
finishing moves.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the acceleration during the 
final stretch, I believe establishing it 
as a special move with a definitive name 
would greatly boost morale.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
So then, between 'Valkyrie's Swordplay' 
and 'Sacred Over'—which one strikes your 
fancy, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Fast, sharp, and valiant. I designed it 
with the image of a knight in mind, while 
also making sure it rolls right off the 
tongue when shouting it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If neither of these suits your fancy, I 
have prepared roughly 50 alternative 
proposals.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now, my liege... your judgment, if you 
will!
